verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's own docs describe rules that ramp up automatically over time and can be scheduled, with ramp schedules listed as a paid feature. That is a real product-native automation that runs unattended once set up, but it is limited to rollout ramps rather than general user-defined background automations. Toggling flags from a deploy script is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. Missing for 10: general-purpose or AI-agent-driven background automations, configurable triggers and actions beyond rollout ramps, in-depth docs on how scheduled automations execute, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
